evidence.text: - **ROSE-CD one-step consistency model**: upstream reports an EARS-Reverb dereverberation comparison (PESQ 2.69, ESTOI .82, WER 15.78%) for a one-step model. The local checkpoint is from VoiceBank-DEMAND; the EARS-Reverb values are cross-domain upstream evidence, not evidence from this exact checkpoint. It is a large utterance-level model and the local CPU screen was too slow to qualify for real-time use.
